description: Report recorded campaign outcomes: leads, sent records, confirmed delivery receipts, replies, opt-outs, booking records, and AI-paused leads (not people awaiting a human). Omit campaign_id to list campaigns. Account totals are independent of pagination and status filters. Read-only. Null metrics are unavailable; read the caveats before telling the operator a campaign is or is not working.

campaign_id.description: One campaign. Omit to list all of them.

status.description: Filter the list by status, e.g. 'active', 'draft', 'paused'.

name: get_campaign_status
title: Get campaign status
